messages:
Rohit: Hey team — pushed updates to PR #4823 addressing the shard-fallback race we saw in canary. Added unit + integration tests and a small `fallback_window_ms` config. CI is flaky in cloud runners but green locally. Please re-review when you have a sec; thinking of scheduling a canary in the next ops window if nothing blocks.
Sofia: Quick Q — is the new behavior behind a flag so we can rollback quickly if needed?
Rohit: Yes, default=false. Legacy behavior is preserved. Added a short migration note in CHANGELOG. Example config snippet I added:\n```
fallback_window_ms: 250  # conservative default for now
feature_toggle: false
```\n(Avoiding default flip until canary passes.)
Ava: Left one nit about log level verbosity and one test assert (minor). Otherwise looks good to me.
Rohit: Thanks — fixed both (log -> DEBUG, tightened the assert) and pushed a follow-up commit.
Ben: I'll run a quick smoke on dedicated pools in my acct once CI finishes. Ping me when CI is green.
CI-bot: CI status: build passed. unit tests 128/128, integration tests 42/42. Changed files: 7.
(Artifacts: https://ci.internal/4823/567)
Ops-bot: Canary slot booked: 2026-03-19 03:00 UTC (us-west-2). Notifying oncall. Rollback window 30m.
Ben: Ran smoke on my side against the canary image — no obvious regressions in p99 or memory.
Sofia: :thumbsup: from prod side but prefer to wait for canary telemetry before merging.
Rohit: Sounds good. I'll hold merge until canary completes (~3h). If all clear I'll squash+merge and tag release v0.22.5-rc1.
Ava: One question — do we want to keep commit history or squash? My preference is squash for a cleaner changelog.
Rohit: Agreed, I'll squash to keep the changelog concise.
Ben: +1
Sofia: +1
Rohit: Thanks everyone. Will update this thread after canary finishes and post the canary metrics summary.
CI-bot: Canary monitoring: no increase in error rate, latency delta within noise (p50 +1ms, p99 +3ms). Observability graphs: https://metrics.internal/canary/4823
Rohit: Canary passed; merging now. Will watch deploy and post status. :shipit:
thread_text: Follow-up on requested changes: addressed comments, re-requesting review and coordinating canary/merge timing
